narrative: The tables opened on the board after dinner. The same four lines. A crumb is not on the leaf. The bundle is still apart. No face. The stylus is in his hand and does not touch. Grease is on a finger and not on the leaf. No face. He looks at the place where the rubbed word was. He does not write it back. The knot is unchanged. No face.
